title: Unit 21 Consolidation: The Cuban Revolution
goal: Review the unit on the Cuban revolution: Cuba before 1959, the rebels, the socialist turn, the Bay of Pigs and the missile crisis, and Cuba in Latin America.

items: I can sum up how things were in Cuba before the revolution and how it began.
I can tell what the rebels had done before Batista fled, using the pluperfect.
I can link changes that grew together, such as the distrust between Cuba and the United States.
I can say what the world was about to do in October 1962.
I can say what was done to Cuba and to Che Guevara.
